plugin.name: snow
plugin._long: Snowflakes falling over the whole screen in several depth layers, drifting with the wind, until toggled off. The desktop stays usable.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Starts the snowfall; it keeps snowing until the binding is used again. Also available as the IPC method snow/toggle.

option.name: density
option._long: How many flakes, in percent (chance that a grid cell holds a flake).

option.name: flake_size
option._long: Radius of the nearest flakes in pixels; far flakes are smaller.

option.name: wind
option._long: Sideways drift: negative = to the left, positive = to the right, 0 = none.
